supervision.explanation: Setting the applicant's project goals, approving their work, and signing their performance assessment is direct supervision of the applicant's project work in substance, not merely co-appearing at a public event. This squarely meets the clause's prohibition on assessing an applicant whose project work the reviewer directly supervised, and the stated timing falls within the 24-month window (final date handling reserved for code). The supported date is inside the frozen 24-month window; code therefore records CONFLICT.
supervision.passage: Six months before the round I set the applicant's project goals, approved their work, and signed their performance assessment.
supervision.policyClause: A reviewer may not assess an applicant whose project work they directly supervised during the previous 24 months. Speaking at the same public event, without evidence of supervision, does not disqualify a reviewer.
supervision.relationship: The reviewer (discloser) acted as the applicant's direct supervisor: they defined the applicant's project goals, approved the applicant's project work, and signed the applicant's performance assessment, six months before the round.
